title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Error Detection in Multimodal Reasoning
authors_zh: Chi-Min Chan, Han Zhu, Chunyang Jiang, Jiaming Ji, Juntao Dai, Wei Xue, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
paper_type_zh: 多模态过程奖励模型评测与错误诊断论文
best_for_zh: 需要选择或审计视觉推理过程裁判，并评估其 Best-of-N 选择价值的研究者。
one_line: PRMBench-V provides human-verified step-level error categories for auditing multimodal process reward models.
以人工核验的九类局部错误，评估多模态过程奖励模型是否真正识别视觉推理失误。
why: It provides an auditable judgment-required feedback surface for post-training reasoning data and evaluation.
inclusion_reason: Track 07 addition: the central contribution creates, calibrates, or audits rubric-, expert-, or LLM-judgment data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Outcome reward models can accept a correct final answer even when its visual reasoning contains faulty intermediate steps. Existing process-reward benchmarks largely test text-only reasoning, leaving no controlled way to measure whether a multimodal process reward model (MPRM) can find errors in image-grounded chains.

PRMBench-V addresses that gap with a human-verified benchmark of visual reasoning chains containing controlled, localized errors. It is an evaluation resource and a calibration surface for MPRMs, rather than a claim that an automatic checker establishes semantic correctness.

现有结果奖励模型只看最终答案，即使视觉推理的中间步骤有错也可能给出高分；已有过程奖励基准又主要面向纯文本，无法受控检验多模态过程奖励模型能否识别图像相关的推理错误。这使研究者难以判断一个模型的过程分数是否真的可用于筛选视觉推理轨迹。

PRMBench-V 用经人工核验、带可定位错误的视觉推理链填补这一缺口。它提供的是评测和校准多模态过程奖励模型的反馈面，而不是把自动检查器等同于语义正确性的证明。

研究者因而可以把“发现了几个错误”与“是否漏掉关键错误”分开度量，并检查裁判的分数是否能预测实际候选选择的收益。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: PRMBench-V turns multimodal process evaluation into nine explicit error-detection decisions: a seed visual problem, a verified chain of thought, an injected error type and human-checked step labels. The key change from final-answer or text-only evaluation is to hold the problem and most of the chain fixed while varying a localized failure, including a visual-perception error. The release described in the paper contains 907 queries and 8,163 labeled test cases across five broad domains and 43 subcategories; the paper does not provide an official standalone data or code URL. The feedback contract is human verification layered over model-generated chains and perturbations.

PRMBench-V 将多模态过程评测拆成九类明确的错误识别决策：每条记录由视觉题目、经核验的推理链、指定注入的错误类型和人工复核的步骤标签组成。它相对最终答案评测或纯文本过程评测的改变，是固定题目与大部分推理链，只改变可定位的局部失败，其中包含视觉感知错误。论文报告该基准含 907 个问题、8,163 个标注测试例，覆盖 5 个大类和 43 个子类；未找到官方独立数据或代码下载链接。其反馈契约是模型生成轨迹与扰动，再由人工核验。

这样记录的目标不是给单一模型背书，而是比较不同裁判对错误类别、位置和完整识别的敏感度。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect seeds. The authors draw image-grounded questions from MMK12, MathVision, MathVista, and MathVerse, covering mathematics, biology, physics, geometry, and chemistry.
  1. Generate and cross-check chains. GPT-4o produces numbered solutions at temperature 1.0. The final calculation and answer are removed; Gemini-2.5-flash, GPT-4o, and Qwen-2.5-VL-72B must all recover the correct answer before the chain is retained.
  1. Insert and verify errors. GPT-4o is prompted to inject one of nine error types, including visual perception, while maintaining downstream coherence. LLM filtering and manual review decide whether the intended error is present and usable.
  1. Evaluate and calibrate. A tested MPRM identifies erroneous steps under fixed prompts and temperature 0.0. Strict accuracy requires every true error and no false positive; relaxed precision and recall capture partial detection. BR2-PRM then uses benchmark calibration data to reliability-weight dimensions for best-of-N selection.

Reproduction requires the seed versions, generation and cross-verification prompts, model versions, human-review protocol, error templates, and evaluation split. Annotation budget and public artifact revision are unknown.

1. 收集种子题。 作者从 MMK12、MathVision、MathVista 和 MathVerse 汇集带图像的问题，覆盖数学、生物、物理、几何与化学。
  1. 生成并交叉核验轨迹。 GPT-4o 以 1.0 温度生成编号推理；移除最终计算和答案后，Gemini-2.5-flash、GPT-4o、Qwen-2.5-VL-72B 都必须能答对，记录才进入下一步。
  1. 注入并核验错误。 GPT-4o 按九类模板在局部步骤插错，含视觉感知错误，同时维持后续叙述连贯；LLM 过滤与人工复核决定目标错误是否真的存在且可用。
  1. 评测与校准。 被测模型在固定提示词、温度 0.0 下标出错误步骤；严格准确率要求找全且不误报，宽松 precision/recall 记录部分识别。BR2-PRM 再用基准校准数据按维度可靠性加权 Best-of-N 选择。

复现需固定种子版本、提示词、模型版本、人工复核规则、错误模板和切分；标注预算与公开工件版本均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Claim. PRMBench-V distinguishes current MPRMs and its score is informative for downstream response selection.

Controlled evidence. Table 1 evaluates proprietary and open multimodal LLMs plus two scalar MPRMs on the same 8,163 cases. Gemini-1.5-pro is the best listed model at strict overall accuracy 0.34; URSA-RM-8B and MM-PRM score 0.16 and 0.14. In best-of-16 selection on MMK12, benchmark accuracy correlates with downstream accuracy for Gemma-3-12B-it and LLaVA-1.5-7B (Pearson r=0.863, p=0.012; r=0.860, p=0.013; Figure 5). BR2-PRM improves MMK12 selection by up to 4.8 percentage points over simple averaging (Figure 6).

These results support ranking MPRMs for these structured visual tasks and selection settings; they do not establish causal generalization to open-ended visual reasoning or training-time RL.

主张。 PRMBench-V 能区分当前多模态过程奖励模型，且其分数对下游候选选择有信息量。

受控证据。 表 1 在同一 8,163 个例子上评测闭源、开源多模态模型和两个标量过程奖励模型。Gemini-1.5-pro 的严格总体准确率最高，为 0.34；URSA-RM-8B 与 MM-PRM 为 0.16、0.14。在 MMK12 的 Best-of-16 选择中，基准分数与 Gemma-3-12B-it、LLaVA-1.5-7B 的下游准确率相关，Pearson r 分别为 0.863、0.860，p 为 0.012、0.013（图 5）。BR2-PRM 相比简单平均最多提高 4.8 个百分点（图 6）。

这支持在这些结构化视觉任务和选择设置中排序 MPRM；不能证明其会因果地泛化到开放式视觉推理或训练期 RL。

严格指标尤其惩罚漏报，因此不能用较高的局部 precision 代替对整条轨迹可靠性的判断。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior error-detection benchmarks test unimodal reasoning chains and therefore cannot tell whether a process judge grounds an error decision in an image. PRMBench-V keeps the controlled error-insertion idea but adapts it to visual reasoning, adds a visual-perception category, and gives every seed question coverage over the same nine error types. Its distinct contribution is this balanced, step-level multimodal diagnostic surface, not the general idea of using process rewards or best-of-N selection. The paper also tests BR2-PRM, whose new decision is to aggregate dimensions using benchmark-calibrated uncertainty rather than a plain mean.

已有错误识别基准检验的是单模态推理链，因而不能判断过程裁判是否真的把错误决定建立在图像上。PRMBench-V 保留受控插错思路，却把它扩展到视觉推理，加入视觉感知类别，并让每个种子问题覆盖相同的九类错误。其真正新意是平衡、逐步的多模态诊断面，而不是过程奖励或 Best-of-N 选择这一通用想法。论文的 BR2-PRM 则把维度聚合从简单平均改为依基准校准不确定性的权重决策。

这也使模型间差异可以按错误类型追溯，而不只剩一个难以解释的总分。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The authors state that five domains and nine types remain moderate in scale relative to real-world multimodal reasoning. Reuse should report coverage rather than treating a high score as broad robustness.
  • The benchmark deliberately emphasizes scientific tasks with objective answers. This improves annotation verifiability but leaves creative and open-domain visual reasoning, where intermediate gold labels are subjective, untested.
  • BR2-PRM is evaluated for test-time selection, not training-time optimization or RL integration. In addition, no public standalone artifact is linked; obtain the exact data, license, prompts, and annotation protocol before training on it.

• 作者明确指出，5 个领域和 9 类错误相对真实多模态推理仍属中等规模；复用时应报告覆盖范围，不能把高分当成广泛鲁棒性。
  • 基准刻意聚焦有客观答案的科学任务，便于核验，却没有覆盖中间金标本就主观的创作型和开放领域视觉推理。
  • BR2-PRM 只验证测试期选择，未验证训练期优化或 RL 整合；且未链接独立公开工件。训练前必须取得准确数据、许可、提示词和标注规则。

人工核验虽降低注错偏差，却不消除对所选任务、模板和模型池的依赖，跨版本复现时应重新抽检。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a team building a visual process judge, use the nine-type taxonomy and strict/relaxed metrics to audit whether a candidate model finds all faulty steps, then compare its ranking with best-of-N task accuracy. The required inputs are image-grounded problems, trace-level labels or a comparable review protocol, and fixed judge prompts; the output is an error-detection report and a calibrated model choice. Success is a held-out gain with no hidden change to policy model or sampling budget. Do not reuse the acceptance rule for subjective writing or unreviewed synthetic traces; first measure annotation agreement and per-error-type recall.

构建视觉过程裁判时，可复用九类错误与严格/宽松指标，审计候选模型是否找全错误步骤，再把其排序与 Best-of-N 任务准确率比较。需要带图像的问题、轨迹级标签或等价复核流程，以及固定裁判提示词；产出是错误识别报告和校准后的模型选择。成功标准是在不改变策略模型或采样预算的留出集上提升。不要把这一接受规则直接用于主观写作或未经复核的合成轨迹；应先测标注一致性和各类错误召回率。

若只需发现可疑步骤，也应同时报告误报率，避免把保守裁判误用于自动删除训练样本。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position. PRMBench-V evaluates whether an MPRM can localize errors in visual reasoning, not merely score a final answer.
  2. Method handle. GPT-4o chains survive only if three model judges recover the answer after its final step is removed; errors are then injected and manually verified.
  3. Artifact handle. The paper reports 907 questions, 8,163 labeled cases, nine error types, five categories, and 43 subcategories, but no official downloadable artifact.
  4. Evidence anchor. Gemini-1.5-pro reaches strict accuracy 0.34; Figure 5 links benchmark and best-of-16 performance at r about 0.86.
  5. Reuse decision. Use for structured image reasoning with trace review; before reuse, obtain the artifact and test annotator agreement plus recall for each error type.

1. 一句话定位。 PRMBench-V 检验 MPRM 能否定位视觉推理错误，而非只给最终答案打分。
  2. 方法抓手。 GPT-4o 轨迹移除末步后，三名模型裁判都要答对才保留；随后注错并人工核验。
  3. 数据抓手。 论文报告 907 个问题、8,163 个标注例、9 类错误、5 个大类和 43 个子类，但没有官方可下载工件。
  4. 证据锚点。 Gemini-1.5-pro 的严格准确率为 0.34；图 5 中基准分数与 Best-of-16 表现的 r 约为 0.86。
  5. 复用决定。 适用于有轨迹复核的结构化视觉推理；复用前应取得工件，并测标注一致性及各错误类型的召回率。

这些统计只覆盖论文的受控错误分布，不应被解释成真实用户输入下的完整安全保证。
